en.title: Work with Hugging Face Hub
en.description: Find, download, and manage Hub models, datasets, and repositories with hf.
tasks: Find, download, and manage Hub models, datasets, and repositories with hf.
prerequisites: The hf CLI, network access, and Hub authentication for private or write operations.
en.example: Use hf-cli. List the files in this model repository and download only the configuration and tokenizer.
en.expectedResult: A file inventory and a scoped download with clear paths and revision.
limitations: Uploads, deletions, deployments, and paid jobs are separate consequential operations.

zh.title: 使用 Hugging Face Hub CLI
zh.description: 通过 hf 查找、下载和管理 Hub 模型、数据集及仓库。
tasks: 通过 hf 查找、下载和管理 Hub 模型、数据集及仓库。
prerequisites: hf CLI、网络连接；私有资源和写入操作需要 Hub 登录。
zh.example: 请使用 hf-cli：列出此模型仓库的文件，只下载配置与分词器。
zh.expectedResult: 文件清单、范围明确的下载及路径和版本记录。
limitations: 上传、删除、部署和付费任务属于需单独核对的操作。
